Study with us enquiries

UK students

If you have any questions about undergraduate or postgraduate study, please visit our Help and Support pages. You can also:

  • General enquiries - use our online enquiry form and we'll get back to you within three working days
  • For accommodation enquiries, visit our accommodation page
  • Call us on +44(0)115 9515 559. Lines are open from 11am to 3pm, Monday to Friday, excluding Bank Holidays
  • Send us a message on WhatsApp: 07403638286
  • Send us an SMS: 07447980972
 

International students

If you have a question, use our enquiry form and we will reply to you soon.

You can also contact our international team directly.
